_comment: Dead-channel deny-list for buffer-post-prep. A channel listed here HAS followers (so it passes the skill-level min_followers_to_promote=50 guard) but is dead by ENGAGEMENT — fan-out to it is wasted. buffer-post-prep SKIPS any post whose target matches a row by `channel_id` OR by `service`+`handle` (both case-insensitive; a leading @ on the handle is ignored). On a match it prints a JSON {"skipped": true, "reason": "..."} object and exits 75. EMPTY = OFF: only channels listed here are ever skipped. This committed file is the seed/default; an operator can shadow it with a gitignored dead-channels.local.json (same shape) to extend the list without a commit. To add a channel: append a row with at least `channel_id` (preferred — stable) and a `reason` citing the audit doc. To re-enable a channel: remove its row (and revisit audits/<channel>-dead-channel.md).

dead_channels.reason: dead channel (0 reactions/0 comments over 64 posts in 30d; 19 followers; see audits/threads-evc-dead-channel.md, task #379)
